text:
ravi: Kickoff for "Newsletter Symphony"  a compact launch drip tied to the benchmark webinar + a follow-up playbook. Need final segment CSV, timezone-aware send windows, subject families, and the inbound-routing rules. Dropping the draft here. @zoe @anya please review.

zoe: Love the name. Quick ask: can we prioritize trialers and newsletter-engaged users, then test a curiosity cohort for long-tail reactivation? Proposed local send windows: APAC 08:30 local, NA 11:00 local, EMEA 16:00 local.

anya: Segment CSV (preview):
```
segment_id,filter,notes
symphony_trial_7d,trial_start<=7d,high-intent trialers
symphony_engaged_14d,last_open<=14d,newsletter & product engagers
symphony_cold_365,last_engagement>365d,reactivation test
symphony_enterprise,account_tier=enterprise,hold-for-approval
```
Exclude `no_email`, `privacy_review`, and any unsubscribed users in 30d. Also exclude recipients with `inbound_block=true`.

max_ops: Ops constraints: daily delivery cap 1.0M. Recommend concurrency 180, batch_size 140. Provider throttle: 5k/min. Ramp plan: `--ramp 10m --batch 140`. Failover: on provider 5xx > 2% for 4m, route failing recipients to s3://marketing/symphony/fallback.csv and switch provider. If 4xx complaints exceed 1% in 10m, auto-pause region and alert #deliverability.

deliverability-bot: Quick check: current sending reputation window good. Recommend limiting image-to-text ratio for cold cohorts and avoid AMP. Also flag enterprise segment for manual RD approval before live send.

ravi: Creative asks: three subject families please: 1) Direct value (cost/latency), 2) Curiosity (surprising benchmark insight), 3) Social proof (customer quote). Keep one short variant <=40 chars. Zoe, can the copy team draft variants?

zoe: Draft subjects: A) "Redwood benchmarks: cut token cost 2x" B) "We found an unexpected throughput win" C) "How Acme reduced inference latency". Short variant: "Benchmarks + playbook". Preheaders: "Register + quickstart" / "Webinar + config pack".

anya: Cadence proposal: invite -> 36h reminder -> 72h reminder -> 2h live nudge -> post-webinar recap (replay + playbook). For symphony_trial_7d shorten to invite -> 24h -> 48h -> recap. For cold_365 use a stretched cadence: invite -> 5d follow-up -> 10d nudge.

max_ops: Please drop final CSV at s3://marketing/symphony/segments_v3.csv. Ops will pick it up and schedule. We'll run a staged roll: 10% warm, 40% ramp, remaining 50% after 30m if metrics healthy. Throttle flags in the send script: `--max-per-min 5000 --connections 200`.

mailer-bot: File detected at s3://marketing/symphony/segments_v3.csv. Verifying header integrity and sample sizes. MD5: 8e2b4f9a6c3d2f1b0a9c7d6e5f4b3a2c.

max_ops: Scheduling epoch 2998848000 for the main invite. Staged deploy plan:
```
stage1: 10% (warm) -> monitor 15m
stage2: 40% (ramp) -> monitor 30m
stage3: 50% -> full send
failover: move failing recipients to s3://marketing/symphony/fallback.csv
```
If bounce_rate>2.5% regionally for 20m, auto-pause and notify #deliverability.

ravi: Inbound routing: include a one-question RSVP (primary use-case) to map to lead queues: `inbound:platform`, `inbound:ops`, `inbound:app`. Responses generate leads tagged `symphony` and route to SDR. Also, any reply "book demo" should create `high_intent` lead immediately.

zoe: Tracking: use utm_campaign=newsletter_symphony_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=campaign. Add header `X-Campaign: newsletter_symphony_v1` and per-variant `utm_content=suspect|value|social` to measure subject lifts.

anya: A/B plan: engaged_14d -> 60/40 value/curiosity. trial_7d -> 70/30 value/social. cold_365 -> equal split across three families. We'll measure opens, CTR, register-rate, watch-time, and 7-day trial activation. We'll also pipe cohort conversions into Optimize for token-cost delta analysis.

deliverability-bot: Note: for cold_365 cohort keep plain-text fallback and low image payloads. Recommend suppressing tracking pixels for the first send and enabling on follow-ups to reduce initial spam-folder risk.

max_ops: One ops request: export a 500-recipient preview per segment for inbox QA to s3://marketing/symphony/preview_samples.csv. Expect that within 30m of CSV upload.

ravi: Great. @anya can you push final CSV and creative to the S3 path and confirm; I'll pin the plan in #marketing and schedule the debrief the Monday after send to review opens, register rates, and downstream conversions. :violin_parrot:
